questions.target: ever vs even / 曾经与甚至
questions.q: Have you ______ attended a blind-review workshop? Surprisingly, the university ______ invited first-year students to participate. Choose the best pair.
o: even / ever
then / even
ever / even
ever / then

exp.trans: 你曾经参加过匿名评审工作坊吗？令人意外的是，学校甚至邀请大一学生参与。
exp.structure: Have you ... attended是现在完成时疑问句；ever修饰attended；Surprisingly在后句提供意外语气，even修饰invited强调连大一学生也被邀请。
exp.other: blind review 匿名评审；workshop 工作坊；first-year student 大一学生；participate 参与。
exp.meaning: ever表示曾经/在任何时候，与现在完成时常见；even表示甚至/连……也，强调程度或意外，两者不可互换。
exp.rest: 把even放在曾经参加的时间提问位置、把ever放在甚至邀请的位置，均改变原意；then只表示随后，不能表达意外程度。

questions.skill: 行动证据与态度变化证据
questions.q: A tenants' group rallied 800 long-time supporters at a public hearing against a proposed rent increase. No survey of participants' earlier opinions was conducted. Which statement is warranted?
o: The campaign converted 800 opponents into supporters.
The gathering shows mobilization of supporters, not necessarily a change in their prior attitudes.
The group persuaded the city to cancel the proposal.
All residents now oppose rent increases.

exp.trans: 租户组织动员了800名长期支持者，在公开听证会上反对拟议涨租。没有调查这些参与者以前的观点。只能确认组织动员了支持者，不能确认他们是被说服后改变立场。
exp.structure: A tenants' group + rallied + long-time supporters；No survey ... was conducted明确缺失了对以前态度的测量。Which statement is warranted要求只说证据足以支持的内容。
exp.other: tenant 租户；rally 动员；hearing 听证会；prior attitude 先前态度。
exp.meaning: rally supporters是组织已有支持者采取行动；change someone's political attitude要有前后立场变化的证据。动员和说服是不同关系。
exp.rest: 转化反对者需要原先反对的证据；城市撤销提案未被提及；把800名支持者扩大为所有居民属于范围过度扩大。

questions.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
questions.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

questions.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
questions.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

questions.target: 排放仍在 vs 部分公司减排
questions.skill: 让步限定防止以偏概全
questions.q: Cargo ships still produce substantial emissions. Nevertheless, several shipping firms have installed cleaner engines to reduce their impact. What is best supported?
o: All firms have eliminated shipping emissions.
Environmental impact has become irrelevant.
The whole shipping sector has refused any cleaner technology.
Some firms have attempted to limit environmental harm despite continuing pollution.

exp.trans: 货船仍然产生大量排放，但部分航运企业已安装清洁型发动机来减轻影响。
exp.structure: The first sentence confirms ongoing harm; Nevertheless introduces partial mitigation, while several limits the number of firms.
exp.other: cargo ship 货船；emissions 排放；shipping firm 航运公司；mitigation 减轻不利影响。
exp.meaning: 污染依旧存在，与部分企业已经尝试治理能够同时为真；不能由存在损害推出全行业完全无视问题。
exp.rest: 所有公司零排放与still冲突；环保影响无关紧要没有依据；全行业拒绝技术与several firms have installed相反。

questions.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
questions.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: A safety bonus can make a workplace more dangerous even when workers welcome it.
Anonymous surveys provide weaker safety evidence than official incident totals.
Workers respond more strongly to anonymity than to financial rewards.
Recorded events can increase because reporting changes, without a matching increase in hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 奖励后上报增多不能证明危险增多，调查反而指出发生频率未变；文中没有比较匿名调查和正式记录的证据等级；匿名是调查方式，奖励是先前制度变化，材料没有直接比较二者激励强度。

questions.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
questions.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
questions.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

questions.target: these/such 回指 / 原词复现干扰
questions.skill: 原词复现 vs 明确回指
questions.q:
段A：The team lost radio contact, and its spare battery failed.
段B：These failures forced the team to abandon the search.
段C：Another team tested a radio before leaving camp.

哪两个段落之间的衔接最强？
o: A → C
B → C
C → A
A → B

exp.trans: 段A：团队失去了无线电联系，备用电池也出了故障。段B：这些故障迫使团队放弃搜寻。段C：另一支团队离开营地前测试了一台无线电设备。
exp.structure: 段A有两个并列分句：The team + lost + radio contact；its spare battery + failed。段B：These failures（主语，概括前面的两项故障）+ forced（谓语）+ the team（宾语）+ to abandon the search（宾语补足语）。段C的Another team引入另一对象。
exp.other: radio contact 无线电联系；spare 备用的；abandon 放弃；search 搜寻。
exp.meaning: These failures明确回指已出现的两次故障；重复radio一词并不保证谈的是同一团队、同一事件。
exp.rest: 把两个含radio的句子相接，会忽略Another team造成的对象切换。把这些故障放在另一团队测试设备之前，后句没有承接故障结果。先说另一团队测试再说本团队出故障，也没有明确回指建立连接。

cloze-time-adverbs.q: The interviewers first rated each applicant on a five-point scale. The scores were ______ combined with a written test result before the committee made its final decision.
o: ever
then
even
unless

exp.trans: 面试官先用五分制给申请者打分，随后将这些分数与笔试成绩合并，最后由委员会作出决定。
exp.structure: first标出初始步骤；The scores were then combined...是被动结构；before引出后续委员会决策，整个流程有清楚的先后顺序。
exp.other: rate 评分；scale 量表；written test 笔试；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: then表示接着/随后；ever强调在任何时候或曾经；even强调甚至/出乎意料；在中性流程描述中then最精确。
exp.rest: ever不能自然表达流程先后；even无须强调出人意料的递进；unless引导条件从句，不能直接充当这个位置的流程副词。

inference-boundary.target: 重新审视惯例 vs 无依据的未来结果
inference-boundary.skill: 推断必须有直接语义支撑
inference-boundary.q: An architect argues: 'When an old street layout fails its users, we should question the layout instead of assuming that pedestrians are the problem.' Later the article mentions plans to renovate the district. Which view is most directly supported by the architect's remark?
o: Old designs should be reconsidered when experience reveals their limits.
Every renovation will inspire a generation of future architects.
Pedestrian choices have no effect on city traffic.
New designs should always replace old ones, even when they work.

exp.trans: 建筑师认为，旧道路布局若不能服务使用者，就应质疑布局本身，而不是预设行人有问题。引文支持反思既有设计，而非预言未来创新的效果。
exp.structure: When从句给出条件；we should question A instead of assuming B是核心主张。Later句子另行交代翻修计划，但没有为引文添加未来代际因果关系。
exp.other: layout 布局；pedestrian 行人；renovate 翻修；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 引用某人的一句话，优先提炼这句话本身可支持的思考方式。与文章主题有关的后续结果可能合理，但若引文没谈到，就不能据此归给说话人。
exp.rest: 鼓舞未来建筑师引入未提及的影响链；完全否认行人作用和一律淘汰旧设计，都比原话更绝对。

inference-boundary.target: 思考方式 vs 后代研究因果
inference-boundary.q: A historian says of a newly revised account: 'The documents did not change; the questions I asked of them did.' The article later notes that her book was reprinted thirty years later. What does her statement most strongly suggest?
o: An influential book must be reprinted before its argument becomes valid.
Repeatedly publishing the same documents automatically produces new discoveries.
Revisiting familiar evidence with different questions can yield new interpretations.
The historian's method necessarily shaped every later generation of researchers.

exp.trans: 历史学家说：文献没有改变，改变的是我向它们提出的问题。这表明熟悉的证据也能因为新的提问方式产生新解释。
exp.structure: The documents did not change与the questions ... did形成对照；did代替did change，省略重复的动词原形change。后句reprinted thirty years later说的是再版事实，不包含对后代研究的必然影响。
exp.other: historian 历史学家；document 文献；reprint 再版；interpretation 解释。
exp.meaning: ‘旧材料+新问题→新解释’是引文直接支持的内容。后面提及多年后再版，并不能证明她影响了所有后来研究，更不能把时间先后直接改成因果。
exp.rest: 把再版当成论证有效性的必要条件属于添加规则；自动产生发现与提问改变的机制不符；对所有后代研究产生必然影响远超引文证据。

inference-boundary.target: 态度确有变化 vs 是否由活动造成
inference-boundary.q: After a public campaign, a survey of the same 500 residents found support for the new bus plan had risen from 30% to 55%. During the same period, a fare cut was also announced. What is the most defensible conclusion?
o: The campaign alone caused every changed opinion.
Support was measured to have risen, but the campaign's independent causal effect is not established.
There is no evidence anyone's opinion changed.
The fare cut certainly had no influence on residents.

exp.trans: 一场宣传活动之后，对同一批500名居民的调查发现，新公交方案支持率从30%升至55%；与此同时还宣布降低车费。能确定支持率发生变化，但不能断定全由宣传活动造成。
exp.structure: a survey ... found + that支持率变化；During the same period引入另一同时发生的因素，阻止将全部变化归因于campaign。
exp.other: fare cut 降低票价；resident 居民；causal effect 因果效应；establish 证实。
exp.meaning: 这次确有前后态度数据，因此不能机械否认变化；但‘变化发生了’与‘某活动单独导致变化’仍是两回事。推断题要守住证据提供的层级。
exp.rest: alone和every绝对化且忽略票价变化；‘没有证据变化’与同群体前后调查冲突；完全排除票价影响没有依据。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It proves the article has reached its final sentence.
It summarizes the first phase before the article moves to further analysis.
It introduces a completely unrelated example.
It means the following claim is uncertain.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 总结词可以出现在文章中段，不能凭Overall就判断是最后一句；unrelated example是引例功能，与概括相反；Overall不表达不确定性，uncertain更接近possibly/apparently等语气词。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

concession-claim-scope.target: some与all / 尝试不等于成功
concession-claim-scope.q: A city festival generated considerable disposable-cup waste. Some stalls started using returnable cups, but single-use cups remained common. Which conclusion is justified?
o: No stall has taken any step to reduce waste.
Some stalls are trying to cut waste, although the problem persists.
All festival waste has been eliminated.
Every customer has stopped buying drinks in disposable cups.

exp.trans: 节庆活动产生了大量一次性杯子垃圾；少数摊位尝试使用可重复使用的杯子，不过一次性杯子仍很常见。
exp.structure: Some stalls started...交代部分行动；but...remained common限制实施效果，两句必须同时保留。
exp.other: disposable 一次性的；returnable 可回收再使用的；persist 持续存在；stall 摊位。
exp.meaning: some不能扩大为整个活动；部分努力不代表问题完全解决，而仍有垃圾也不表示完全无人行动。
exp.rest: 完全无举措否认原文明示的行动；垃圾彻底消除与remained common冲突；所有顾客拒买无证据。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

scope-role-match.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
scope-role-match.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
scope-role-match.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。

reference.q:
段A：The museum lowered ticket prices and added evening hours.
段B：Such changes attracted more local families during the week.
段C：A different museum across town raised its prices last year.

段B中的 Such changes 最直接回指什么？
o: 段A中的降价和延长晚间开放时间
段C中另一家博物馆的涨价
所有博物馆过去一年的变化
local families 本身

diag.1: 段B先于段C，且 Such changes 就近概括段A的两个措施。
diag.2: 题干没有支持“所有博物馆”的泛指。
diag.3: changes 指的是措施变化，不是家庭。

exp.trans: A：博物馆降低了票价，并延长了晚间开放时间。B：这些变化吸引了更多本地家庭在工作日前来。C：城另一边的另一家博物馆去年提高了票价。
exp.structure: 段A先给出两个并列措施 lowered ticket prices / added evening hours；段B用 Such changes 对这两个措施整体回指，再说明结果 attracted more local families。
exp.other: lower 降低；ticket price 票价；evening hours 晚间开放时段；attract 吸引。
exp.meaning: such + 名词 常把前文已经描述过的同类事物/情况概括回指；这里 Such changes = 段A的两项变化。
exp.rest: 后文另一家博物馆的涨价、所有博物馆的泛指以及 local families 都不是 Such changes 的先行内容；它直接概括前文的降价和延长晚间开放时间。

reference.q:
A return is accepted only within thirty days and with a receipt. These requirements apply to online orders too.
These requirements 具体指什么？
o: 网上订单本身
所有商店的规定
三十天以内退货且出示收据这两个条件
退款已经完成这一结果

exp.trans: 只有在三十天内并出示收据，退货才会被受理。这些要求也适用于网上订单。
exp.structure: 第一句：A return（主语）+ is accepted（被动谓语）；only within thirty days和with a receipt并列限制受理条件。第二句：These requirements（主语）+ apply（谓语）+ to online orders（介词短语）。
exp.other: return 退货；receipt 收据；apply to 适用于；online order 网上订单。
exp.meaning: these + 名词可以概括前文的整组条件，不一定只指紧挨着它的一个名词。
exp.rest: online orders是第二句中被这些要求约束的对象，不是要求本身。所有商店的规定扩大了范围，原文未说all shops。退款完成是结果，但前句只陈述受理规则，没有报告任何实际退款。

reference.target: it / this request / 对象切换
reference.q: Two panels examined a report. The finance panel recommended publishing it in full, while the technical panel asked for more time. This request was granted. Which reading tracks it and This request correctly?
o: it = the report; This request = publishing the report in full
it = the finance panel’s recommendation; This request = more time
it = the report; This request = more time for the technical panel
it = the decision to publish; This request = the finance panel’s recommendation

exp.trans: 两个小组审阅了一份报告。财务小组建议全文发布它，技术小组则请求更多时间。这个请求获准了。it指报告；This request指技术小组请求更多时间。
exp.structure: publishing it in full是recommended的补足内容，it代替前文的report。while对比两个小组的不同动作。This request作后句主语；was granted是被动谓语，回指asked for more time这一请求。
exp.other: panel 小组；in full 全文、完整地；technical 技术的；grant a request 批准请求。
exp.meaning: 跟踪对象时既看名词数与位置，也看动作：publish的是report，asked for形成request。财务组的建议和技术组的请求不能混为同一对象。
exp.rest: 把This request指向全文发布，忽略asked for more time和while的对象切换；把it解释成recommendation，会把publish报告改成发布建议；decision to publish也不是it出现前已建立的实体，且没有说发布决定已经获批。
